items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 1 at 3:55AM EST until November 2 at 5:00AM EST by NWS Key West FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Middle and Lower Florida Keys.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM EST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and lots
is expected. Some storm drains will overflow, and some
seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less
clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that
persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost
certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 1 at 9:01AM EST by NWS Key West FL
items.description:
Through 1100 am, scattered showers and thunderstorms will continue
to wax and wane while moving west northwest at 10 to 15 knots across
the waters of the Outer Gulf, and nearshore waters surrounding the
Lower Keys. The strongest showers and showers in the midst of
collapse could generate outflow boundaries and wind gusts of 30 to 35
knots, reduced visibility in blinding downpours, and frequent
lightning strikes.
